protocol.name: new_v1_family_roam_synthetic_quality_extension_v1
protocol.source_state: F0v2 Rest thresholds, fault amplitude q95/RMS, family metadata, scaler and classifier use only resting-posture source subjects 1-18. Target corruptions are independent copies of the identical native bouts. No validation/final target state fit.
protocol.classifier: Source-only StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260929; frozen parent F0v2 probabilities must replay across all faults.
protocol.quality_summary: Equal mean of six coordinates: mean of eight dropout-channel macro-F1 values, plus each of five other named-fault macro-F1 values. Clean excluded. Also report minimum individual fault and minimum subject-by-fault F1.
protocol.selection: Select arm by highest validation synthetic-quality family mean macro-F1; tie break by highest validation minimum individual-fault macro-F1, then lower validation mean fault log loss. Final subjects are descriptive only. No arm promoted without checking clean and minimum-fault regressions.
protocol.scope: Fixed synthetic corruptions of public Myo 8-channel 200 Hz static resting bouts, paired across every arm and fault. No real hardware fault, fault prevalence, unseen shift, 250 Hz device or live transition claim.
